write a letter for principal to take leave for permission

Okay, here’s a draft letter you can adapt to send to your principal:

[Your Name]
[Your Class/Roll Number]
[Date]

To,
The Principal,
[School Name]
[School Address]

Subject: Application for Leave of Absence

Respected Madam/Sir,

I am writing to request a leave of absence from school on [Start Date] to [End Date]. [Briefly state reason for leave - e.g., due to a family event, personal reasons, etc.]. 

I will ensure that I complete all pending assignments and catch up on any missed lessons upon my return. 

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]



**Helpful Follow-up Action:** Would you like me to format this letter with a more formal tone, or perhaps add a specific reason for your leave?
